description: This file defines the WifiManagerState class in the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It declares public methods for managing WiFi states, retrieving connected SSID, security modes, and setting WiFi state cache. It also contains private helper methods and member variables related to WiFi status and caching.

classes.name: WifiManagerState
classes.description: A class managing WiFi state, including retrieval and setting of WiFi parameters, with caching mechanisms.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Retrieves the current WiFi state based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Returns the SSID of the connected WiFi network.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the WiFi functionality.

methods.name: getSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Retrieves supported security modes for WiFi.

methods.name: setWifiStateCache
methods.description: Sets the cache for WiFi state with a boolean and WiFi state.

methods.name: retrieveValues
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve values based on provided parameters.
